_README: Photo attribution, hand-authored from evidence, not guessed.
Source: ppt/diagrams/dataN.xml inside 'KEY CUSTOMERS LIST SUCHETANA ELECTRICALS.pptx'.
Each SmartArt diagram groups 2-3 register entries with 2-3 photos, and the media order is
NOT guaranteed to match the entry order. So a photo is attached to a project only when the
evidence is independent of that ordering: visible signage in the frame, or subject matter that
only one client in the group can be. Everything else goes to 'gallery' with a caption describing
what is actually visible and no client name. Putting the wrong client's name on a building is
the one mistake this register cannot survive.
confidence: 'signage' = the client's name is legible in the photo.
'subject'  = only one client in the diagram group matches what the photo shows.
To attribute more, the client must label the originals; then move entries out of 'gallery'.
